title: John the Baptist prepares the way
description: John the Baptist appears in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins. People from all over Judea and Jerusalem come to him, confess their sins, and are baptized in the Jordan River. Dressed in a garment of camel hair with a leather belt, and eating locusts and wild honey, he proclaims that one more powerful is coming after him, someone he is not worthy to untie the sandals of. He baptizes with water, but the one who comes will baptize with the Holy Spirit.
